from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=programs/'task-97151950.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full-width or full-height uniform divider, with equal-sized
    # rectangular panels on its two sides.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            candidates.append((0, r))
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            candidates.append((1, c))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("No equal-panel divider found")
    axis, split = candidates[0]
    if axis == 0:
        a, b = grid[:split], grid[split+1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:split] for row in grid]
        b = [row[split+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)]
            for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.read_text())
